استقضي (form X)
# اُسْتُقْضِيَ (ustuqḍiya) /us.tuq.dˤi.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اِسْتَقْضِي (istaqḍī) /is.taq.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
